safety: The image boots uncommissioned and fails closed with FAULT_CONFIG.
SAFETY_OK must be observed during a held RESET; the release pass cannot newly qualify a cycle, and any blocker requires a new release and press.
The reset protocol was host-tested against the asynchronous DRAFT-02 hardware latch model; physical timing and debounce still require a bench.
The watchdog validator budgets 80 ms between falling edges against the 170 ms minimum timeout, but GPIO and RTOS timing still require oscilloscope verification.
This artifact is for bench verification only and is not authorization for fired operation.
